shared_elements: tall upright slab decorated across its whole face
row of repeated similar creatures in an upper register
justification: Both surfaces divide a tall upright face into stacked horizontal registers separated by a banded border, with profile animals as the main subject, which gives a loose compositional echo. But the specific content differs entirely: A shows isolated, widely spaced silhouetted animals (quadruped, birds, long-necked bird, plant/frond) on an empty ground with no humans, while B shows human figures with horses in the upper panel and a dense interlaced ribbon-animal knot filling the lower panel, a wholly different repertoire and space-filling convention.
